headline: Planning Commission approves Hāna park restroom on second vote

meeting.body: Maui Planning Commission Meeting of October 8, 2024
meeting.summary: The Maui Planning Commission approved a coastal-zone permit for a warehouse and, after a failed first vote, a state park restroom near Hāna.
meeting.recap: A new condition requires 100% solar energy within two years of the building's certificate of occupancy.[[0:26:36]] Another added condition sends roof rainwater to landscaped areas.[[0:33:58]] The warehouse permit passed with all ayes.[[0:36:00]] The commission took up a permit for a new comfort station (public restroom) at a state park near Hāna.[[0:36:46]] A lineal descendant said families are still not happy with the restroom's location.[[1:16:52]] A composting toilet maker testified that dry toilets would have no discharge because the liquid evaporates.[[1:33:53]] The first vote to approve the restroom permit failed with four ayes.[[3:24:18]] A commissioner who voted no said they were concerned about nitrogen reaching the ocean.[[3:25:10]] The commission changed the condition to require a unit that maximizes nutrient reduction in the wastewater.[[3:32:05]] A second vote approved the restroom permit 5 to 1, with 14 conditions.[[3:39:30]] The director reported a change of permit holder for a Kapalua workforce housing project.[[3:40:28]] The next meeting is October 22.[[3:54:08]] One item on that agenda would help rebuild units damaged during the fire.[[3:54:36]]
decided: redirect roof water to landscaped areas: The commission added a condition directing roof water to landscaped areas on a roll-call vote.
The commission approved a friendly amendment adding conditions 13 and 14 to the restroom permit.
The first motion to approve the restroom permit did not carry.
The commission approved the restroom permit with 14 conditions, including the revised treatment condition.
meeting.next: The project engineer estimated the restroom redesign and Department of Health approval would take about six months. Staff said they will try to schedule commissioner training as soon as possible.

moments.q: Public testimony on the Hāna restroom begins
"five votes in favor one opposed the motion carries"
